meta.source: User-provided official NZ Lotto results spreadsheet (Lotto Powerball sheet), covering every draw from draw #1 (1 Aug 1987) to the most recent draw at time of upload (draw #2608, 1 Aug 2026). This replaces the earlier 44-draw web-search-compiled dataset now that authoritative source data is available. Updated 2026-08-27: draws #2609-#2615 (5-26 Aug 2026) added via web search (cross-validated against sequential draw numbering and Wed/Sat cadence) since mylotto.co.nz remains unreachable from this environment; the 7 oldest draws (#2509-#2515) were dropped to keep a rolling 100-draw window. Updated 2026-09-16: draws #2616-#2620 (29 Aug - 12 Sep 2026) added via web search (draw #2616 cross-confirmed directly against a screenshot the user took of mylotto.co.nz itself), cross-validated by sequential draw numbering. This catches up a 3-week gap: the Wed/Sat auto-refresh Routine had been firing and updating the published report, but a fresh spawned session lacks this repo's git push credentials, so nothing reached the repository until fixed manually here. Updated 2026-09-19: draw #2621 (16 Sep 2026) added via web search, cross-validated.
meta.validation: Read directly from the workbook, no reconstruction needed. Every one of the 100 rows has a complete 6-number line, bonus ball, and Powerball number -- no missing values. The 2026-08-27 update draws (2609-2615) were reconstructed from search snippets, not read from a workbook -- one (#2609) had its bonus ball duplicated as a 7th "main" number in the source snippet and was corrected accordingly.
meta.note_bonus: Bonus ball (1-40) is the 7th ball drawn from the same barrel as the main 6.
meta.note_powerball: Powerball (1-10) is a separate add-on barrel, present for all 100 draws in this set.
meta.powerball_rule_change: IMPORTANT: NZ Lotto Powerball expanded from a 10-ball pool (1-10) to a 14-ball pool (1-14) effective draw #2621 (16 Sep 2026) -- confirmed via multiple independent news sources (1News, Stuff) and mylotto.co.nz/powerball-changes. All draws #2621 onward use the new 1-14 range; every draw before that (#2620 and earlier, all data back to 1987) used the old 1-10 range. Powerball frequency stats spanning this boundary mix two different underlying probability distributions -- numbers 11-14 will show near-zero historical counts simply because they did not exist as valid outcomes until draw #2621, not because they are cold. Division 8 was also added (fixed prize, 2 main + bonus + powerball) and jackpot odds shifted from 1-in-38.4m to 1-in-53.7m -- this does not affect the main 6-number game or its analysis, only Powerball.

monte_carlo_validation.note: Both should hover near the theoretical expected value (0.9) with no statistically meaningful gap -- confirming the model has no real edge, as expected for a fair, independent lottery draw.
